evals.prompt: We're launching a small budgeting app for couples called 'Kitty' on iOS and Android. We don't have an icon yet. Can you explore a few icon ideas and show me how they'd look on a phone? Friendly but trustworthy, not childish.
evals.expected_output: An icon workbench scaffolded from the skill assets (icon.html, icon.js, icon.css, mockup-core.css, export-icons.sh, outline-text.py) with 3–6 concept entries spanning letterform, symbol and abstract, each with a rationale note; a competitor shelf of neutral placeholder tiles built from described (not copied) finance apps; concepts judged at 60/40/29/16 with squint and one-color tests; screenshots of ?solo=concepts, ?solo=shelf and ?solo=ios presented with a specific question. No real competitor names or marks; no live text in any concept marked chosen.

evals.prompt: Our mockups are in design/mockup (design-system.css has our colors). We picked the 'K' monogram concept in design/icon/icon.html. Make it work in iOS dark and tinted mode and on Android themed icons, then export everything we need for Xcode, the Android res folder and the web manifest.
evals.expected_output: Concept palette roles match design-system.css (designSystem path set, no drift warning); dark and mono palettes added rather than a second drawing; the K outlined to a path with outline-text.py before export; detail that must survive transparency done as mask cut-outs; android composite checked against the 66dp safe zone; export-icons.sh run producing ios 1024 light/dark/tinted, android mipmap layers + anydpi-v26 xml + Play 512, macOS iconset/icns, web favicon set, with verified sizes; handoff instructions for asset catalog, res/, and manifest.

evals.prompt: Users say our app icon is unreadable on Android — the logo gets cut off in the circle and it's a mush in the small settings list. Here's the current SVG. Can you fix it without changing the brand?
evals.expected_output: The existing SVG brought into the workbench as one concept (same colors and mark); the Android section shows the mark crossing the 66dp safe-zone circle and the fix scales/repositions it inside r 469 with the background bleeding to the 108dp layer; an artSmall variant or thickened details for ≤ 32 px verified in ?solo=sizes at 6× pixel zoom; before/after screenshots of android and sizes sections; re-export of the Android layers with verified pixel sizes.
